FMCOMMS3.ZedAddress_comment: IP address of the Zedboard receiver
FMCOMMS3.ZedPort_comment: its TCP port for commands and results
FMCOMMS3.Frequency_MHz_comment: AD9361 receive carrier, MHz, 70 to 6000 (match TxLO_MHz of the Pluto)
FMCOMMS3.RFBandwidth_MHz_comment: AD9361 analog RF bandwidth, MHz (the signal occupies 16.4 MHz)
FMCOMMS3.GainMode_comment: fast_attack (default: TDD bursts), slow_attack, hybrid or manual (the AD9361's gain control)
FMCOMMS3.Gain_comment: manual gain only, dB (-3 to 71); 50 over the air at a few metres
FMCOMMS3.Port_comment: AD9361 Rx input: 0 = A balanced (the FMCOMMS3's RX1A SMA)
FMCOMMS3.Push_ms_comment: the board pushes results at most this often while there are new ones, 0.25 to 7.75 ms
FMCOMMS3.DcShift_comment: receiver DC blocker: 6 (0 gives false triggers from spurs near 0 Hz)
FMCOMMS3.Play_comment: 1: play the received video with ffplay
FMCOMMS3.SaveStream_comment: 1: also save the received stream to App/Video/Received.ts (large)
